observations.publisher: Reuters reporting Finnish Defence Forces statement
observations.summary: Finnish Defence Forces told Reuters it detected a strike on a Russian warship on November 11. Cause, exact location, damage and casualties unconfirmed; Finland said regional security remains stable. This is new official confirmation of a prior-day event, not proof of NATO involvement or a new interstate escalation.
observations.title: Finnish military confirms detection of strike on Russian warship in Gulf of Finland

observations.summary: UK announced new sanctions on Slavneft, energy transport vessels, coal companies and the Vostok Oil project, completing UK sanctions coverage of Russia's ten largest oil producers. Measures are enacted economic pressure amid talks, not direct evidence of military escalation; operational trade impact remains unverified.
observations.title: UK imposes sanctions on Slavneft and Russian energy vessels and entities
